description: This Java class 'GoodreadsBookImport' models the data structure for importing book information from Goodreads, including fields like title, author, rating, date read, and bookshelves, along with a static method to map shelf names to predefined shelf enums.

classes.name: GoodreadsBookImport
classes.description: A data class for importing Goodreads book data, with JSON annotations and a helper method to convert shelf names.

methods.name: toPredefinedShelfName
methods.description: Converts a shelf name string into an optional predefined shelf enum value.
